name: VoCat
tagline: Web control panel for Quectel EC20/EC25 modems
description: VoCat is a web-based control panel for managing Quectel EC20 and EC25 cellular modems. It wraps AT commands, USSD, SMS, eSIM, and proxy configuration into a friendly web UI, all delivered as a single Go binary. For self-hosters and IoT builders who rely on cellular connectivity, VoCat removes the need to hand-roll AT command scripts and gives modem management a proper interface.
highlights: Web UI for managing Quectel EC20/EC25 modems
AT commands, USSD, SMS, eSIM, and proxy control in one place
Single Go binary for easy deployment
A practical interface for self-hosted cellular connectivity
curatorNote: Cellular modem management is usually a pile of AT command scripts. Wrapping it in a clean web UI as a single Go binary is a genuinely useful niche tool for self-hosted connectivity setups.
